title: PPG-MS20 — Compliance Spine (AS9100 + NADCAP + ITAR + CFR Part 11 + ISO 13485 + IATF 16949 + DFARS/CMMC)
description: Closes the regulatory-compliance exposure surfaced by R17 + S08 scrutiny. Adds AS9100 §8.5.2 traceability bundle (operator badge + post version + heat-lot + tool serial + machine cal state), AS9102 FAI auto-emit, NADCAP special-process credentialing, ITAR/EAR classification + segregation, ISO 13485 medical-device QMS hooks, IATF 16949 automotive PPAP/APQP/control-plan hooks, DFARS 252.204-7012 + CMMC 2.0 Level 2 cyber controls (closes S08 medical/auto/CMMC zero-coverage gap), MS8 tier-promotion two-person rule, MS11 calibration NCR/CAR ledger, OSHA LOTO predicate.
rationale: Closes the regulatory-compliance exposure surfaced by R17 + S08 scrutiny. Adds AS9100 §8.5.2 traceability bundle (operator badge + post version + heat-lot + tool serial + machine cal state), AS9102 FAI auto-emit, NADCAP special-process credentialing, ITAR/EAR classification + segregation, ISO 13485 medical-device QMS hooks, IATF 16949 automotive PPAP/APQP/control-plan hooks, DFARS 252.204-7012 + CMMC 2.0 Level 2 cyber controls (closes S08 medical/auto/CMMC zero-coverage gap), MS8 tier-promotion two-person rule, MS11 calibration NCR/CAR ledger, OSHA LOTO predicate.

units.title: AS9100 §8.5.2 traceability bundle in sidecar
units.scope: Extend sidecar with traceability_bundle: {operator_badge, post_version, heat_lot, tool_serials[], machine_cal_state, fixture_id, signature_chain}. Emit on every program.

units.title: AS9102 FAI auto-emit (Form 1/2/3) + balloon-from-GDT
units.scope: Auto-author AS9102 Form 1/2/3 from print + emitted program; balloon characteristics from GD&T; measurement plan tied to probe macros (PPG-MS13/U-PPGM83).

units.title: NADCAP special-process credentialing gate
units.scope: Pre-emit lookup of operator certifications (heat-treat, NDT, EDM, special-process); HARD BLOCK on uncertified operator + restricted operation; AC7102/AC7116 audit hooks.

units.title: ITAR/EAR classification on Customer + Material + Drawing
units.scope: Classification field on every entity; deny-list non-US-person access; encrypted-at-rest; deny cloud Vericut/NCSIMUL on ITAR-flagged jobs; purge-on-deauth.

units.title: MS8 tier-promotion two-person rule + immutable audit log
units.scope: Promotion to production+ tier requires 2nd authorized signature; sim→shop_floor demotion forbidden inside same job; every tier change logged immutably.

units.title: MS11 calibration NCR/CAR ledger (AS9100 §8.5.6 change control)
units.scope: Every kc1.1/Taylor calibration delta routes through NCR/CAR ledger with electronic signature (21 CFR Part 11 if medical leakage); explainable-drift required before constants merge; rollback signature trail.

units.title: OSHA LOTO + machine-guard interlock predicate (PPG-MS14 #9)
units.scope: Pre-emit lock-out/tag-out predicate; machine-guard interlock check; coolant-mist exposure (PEL) check. Adds as PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine predicate #9.

units.title: Compliance audit-readiness package + AS9100 surveillance dry-run
units.scope: Generate compliance evidence package (traceability bundles + tier audit + ITAR classifications + NCR ledger); run AS9100 surveillance dry-run with internal auditor; remediate findings.

units.title: ISO 13485 + IATF 16949 + DFARS/CMMC 2.0 thin wiring (closes S08 zero-coverage gap)
units.scope: Three sub-bands all mounted on existing prism_compliance dispatcher: (a) ISO 13485 medical-device QMS — design-history-file linkage on customer entity, electronic-signature requirement on calibration deltas (extends 21 CFR Part 11), risk-classification audit; (b) IATF 16949 automotive — PPAP package auto-emit, APQP phase tracking, control-plan generation linked to FAI (U-PPGM121), customer-specific requirements (CSR) registry; (c) DFARS 252.204-7012 + CMMC 2.0 Level 2 — covered defense information (CDI) classification, incident reporting <72h, NIST SP 800-171 control mapping (110 controls), supply-chain risk management. Each band gated by customer.compliance_class field on customer entity; HARD BLOCK on missing required artifacts at emit time.
